title: Organizations, Factions, Settlements & Kingdoms
objective: Complete the larger social and political simulation layer using existing MIB relationships, reputation, registries and events.

scope.purpose: Complete the larger social/political simulation layer using MIB relationships, reputation, registries and events.
scope.completion_gate: Representative organization and settlement state evolves deterministically through owner-domain Actions/Events without parallel ledgers.

validation_notes: TDD RED was captured before production code: repository health/profile selection passed and the focused SMB-03 test failed because the production module/evidence did not exist.
Two subsequent candidates exposed TypeScript literal/tuple inference issues only; focused behavior, invariants and deterministic receipts remained green while those typing defects were repaired.
The exact terminal application tree passed Linux, Windows, client typecheck and deterministic cross-platform comparison, and is identical to the squash-merged application tree.
selection_boundaries: SMB-02 was completed_verified before SMB-03 implementation.
Existing MIB-09 relationship/reputation, MIB-11 World/location, ODL organization/leadership, SCL consequence and owner-domain Action/Event foundations were reused rather than duplicated.
Organizations, factions, settlements, governance, territory, services, law and kingdom-scale state remain deterministic projections/compositions over canonical owner-domain identities and events.
No parallel political, relationship, settlement, territory, kingdom, world or Event ledger was created.
No database migration, provider activation, public/tester distribution or SMB-04 implementation was performed.
SMB-04 and later implementation remain unauthorized until separately governed-started.
next_action: SMB-03 is completed_verified. Canonical product state advances to SMB-04 selected_not_started; do not start SMB-04 without a later owner Continue.
